source_preview:
Job Description – IT Sales Executive (Inside Sales)

Experience: 2 – 3 Years
Location: Vikhroli West, Mumbai
Company URL: https://techberryinfotech.com/
Job Summary:
We are looking for a motivated and experienced Inside Sales Executive with 2–3 years of
experience in IT Sales / B2B Sales. The candidate will be responsible for lead generation,
client acquisition, handling sales conversations, understanding customer requirements,
and driving revenue growth through IT service solutions.
Key Responsibilities:
• Generate qualified leads through cold calling, email campaigns, LinkedIn, and other
sales channels.
• Identify potential business clients and create new sales opportunities.
• Promote IT services, software solutions, cloud, infrastructure, and technology
offerings.
• Conduct initial discussions with prospects to understand business requirements.
• Schedule meetings and coordinate with the sales/technical team for further
discussions.
• Manage the complete sales cycle from lead generation to closure.
• Maintain regular follow-ups with prospects and existing clients.
• Maintain accurate records of leads, opportunities, and client interactions.
• Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with clients.
Required Skills & Qualifications:
• Graduate in any discipline.
• 2–3 years of experience in Inside Sales / IT Sales / B2B Sales.
• Experience in selling IT services, software, cloud solutions, or technology products
will be preferred.
• Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
• Strong ability to identify customer needs and provide suitable solutions.
• Good knowledge of lead generation and sales conversion processes.
• Experience working with CRM tools will be an advantage.
• Target-oriented approach with strong follow-up skills.
Preferred Candidate Profile:
• Prior experience in IT service sales or technology solution selling.
• Ability to communicate with decision-makers and enterprise clients.
• Self-driven, proactive, and capable of working independently.
